The new version of the SmartGym iPhone app officially launched today. Users who are accustomed to using the app to record their workout training will find the process of adjusting and logging training sets more convenient. Here are the details.

SmartGym makes adjusting and logging exercise sets during training easier

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has always allowed users to quickly adjust details such as repetitions and weights when recording each set of training.

With today's updated version, this flexibility extends to the iPhone app. Users can now freely choose between the original logging interface and the brand-new "Inline Logging" interface, which allows them to adjust values, log sets, and add new training sets without leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small marker in the bottom-right corner of the repetitions and weight fields, showing the originally set value for each set.

After completing a set log, SmartGym will also start the rest timer directly on the same screen, allowing users to continue training without switching pages.

Here is an introduction to SmartGym:

This feature is significant because SmartGym is positioned not just to record what you did, but to help you understand what you should do. Your training plan is designed to move you toward your goals. Displaying the originally planned sets alongside the sets you actually completed makes it easier for you to stay on track during training, and easier to observe whether you are consistently improving over time.

This update also introduces a keyboard redesigned from scratch, making the logging process during training smoother. The keyboard features buttons that allow you to quickly increase or decrease values, or switch between regular sets, warm-up sets, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save you in the app is a second returned to you to do what truly matters—training."

Finally, this update also includes a redesigned "Smart Action Button," which can predict the most likely next action for the user and display corresponding action options at the bottom of the interface based on the user's position in the workout.

Options include "Log Set and Start Rest," "Start Exercise," "Superset First Set," "Update Set," "Next Exercise," and "Finish Workout," among others.

SmartGym says they have also enhanced the intelligent computation behind the Smart Action Button:

The end result is a feature that feels more natural and fluid to use. SmartGym handles all the complex operations behind the scenes, while users only see exactly what they need at the most appropriate moment.

One last point: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, allowing you to manage your training content more quickly during workouts without repeatedly navigating through different levels of menus within the app.

SmartGym is available for free download on the App Store, with various subscription plans available.
